reply: Thanks for the details, and sorry about the dropouts. Wi-Fi bands often get confused with each other, so mesh routers usually fix this by pushing devices onto the right one. Try this: (1) Create a separate 2.4 GHz network or turn band steering off for a while. (2) Reset the Lumen bulb pack by holding its button for 10 seconds until you see an amber blink. (3) Pair it again from the app on that band. If it drops again within 24 hours, reply with your router model and we will pass it to our network team.

Thanks for the details, and sorry about the connection trouble with your Nook speaker. A mesh router often does this because it pushes devices onto the wrong band, and the Nook speaker connects on 2.4 GHz. Here is what usually fixes it: (1) Create a separate 2.4 GHz network or turn band steering off for a while. (2) Reset the Nook speaker by holding its button for 10 seconds until you see an amber blink. (3) Pair it again from the app on the 2.4 GHz network. If it drops again within 24 hours, reply with your router model and we will pass it to our network team.

Thanks for the details, and sorry about the connectivity trouble with your Nook speaker. A mesh router often sets one of its bands on fire, pushing other devices onto it, so make sure you have a separate 2.4 GHz band. As a courtesy, I disabled band steering on most of our mesh routers. For now, try these steps: (1) In your router app, create a dedicated 2.4 GHz network or turn band steering off for a while. (2) Press and hold the reset button on the Nook speaker for 10 seconds until the light flashes amber. (3) Pair it again from the app on the 2.4 GHz network. If it drops again within 24 hours, reply with your router model and we will pass it to our network team.

Thanks for the details, and sorry about the connection trouble with your Lumen bulb pack. A Lumen bulb pack usually connects on its own 2.4 GHz band, so mesh routers often push it onto the wrong band, causing frequent drops and a bad setup at the Wi-Fi step. Here is what usually fixes it: (1) Create a separate 2.4 GHz network or turn band steering off for a while. (2) Reset the Lumen bulb pack by holding its button for 10 seconds until you see an amber blink. (3) Set it up again in the app on that 2.4 GHz network. If it drops again within 24 hours, reply with your router model and we will pass it to our network team.

Thanks for reporting this. We know about a sync bug in the current app that can leave a Breeze air purifier off or hidden from the device list. Version 4.12.2, rolling out now, fixes it. In the meantime: sign out of the app, force close it, sign back in, and pull down on the device list to refresh. That re-syncs the Breeze air purifier for most people. If it is offline, try running it again later.

Yes, you can return the Sentry doorbell within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, whether it is open or closed. Go to Orders in your account, select the Sentry doorbell order, and tap Start a return. You'll get a prepaid label to print or show at any drop-off point. Your refund depays the original cost of the Sentry doorbell plus shipping costs. If the photo has arrived, send us a new one first so we know what size to use for the return label. We will ship a replacement Sentry doorbell with the damaged one, and you do not need to wait for the return to arrive before the replacement ships.

Good news: you can set that up inside the app without any third-party tools. Open the Ember thermostat, tap Automations, then Add. Choose a trigger (a time, sunrise or sunset, or an event from another device such as the doorbell), then choose what the Ember thermostat should do. Save it and it runs on the device itself, so your phone doesn't need to be nearby. For voice control, turn on the Nook Home skill in Alexa or the Nook Home action in Google Home, and the Ember thermostat will appear automatically once you link your account.

Yes, you can turn it on by going to Settings > Smart home > Nook Home, selecting the Sentry doorbell skill from the list, and turning it on. The device will appear automatically once you link your account. If you already have the Nook Home skill installed, simply toggle it off and back on again. For voice control, select the Nook Home skill in Alexa or the Nook Home action in Google Home, and the Sentry doorbell will show up afterward. To download a clip from the app before the battery runs out, tap Download from the app, then Select a trigger (a time, sunrise or sunset, or an event from another device such as the doorbell) and choose what the Sentry doorbell should do next. Automations run on the device itself, so they continue running even when your phone is away. For more information, see Set up your smart home devices.

Good news: you can set that up yourself.
